articles.summary:
• Discover how radio algorithms developer Nils Fredrikson combines mathematics, software and hands-on lab work to solve some of the telecom industry's most complex challenges.
  • Learn why engineers from diverse academic backgrounds can thrive in Ericsson Radio and help shape the future of connectivity.
articles.title: Inside the challenging engineering work powering Ericsson Radio with Nils Fredrikson

articles.summary:
• The IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) has been selected as the communication engine for 6G, ensuring continuity for telephony, emergency services and roaming across the next generation of mobile networks.
  • Continuity is only one part of the story – with data channels, exposure APIs and AI integration, IMS is quickly evolving into a robust foundation for intelligent, real-time communication services.
articles.title: IMS in 6G: From telephony foundation to intelligent communication platform
